annotation.title_clean: Final Report: Toward Harmonized AI Policies and Recommendations for the Caribbean
annotation.title_en: Final Report: Toward Harmonized AI Policies and Recommendations for the Caribbean
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Caribbean AI Task Force (CAITF), Caribbean Telecommunications Union
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Final report of the CTU Caribbean AI Task Force recommending harmonized regional AI policy across seven pillars: data and compute infrastructure, governance and ethics, economic transformation, talent, public sector AI, climate resilience, and regional leadership. It argues isolated national strategies are insufficient given governance, coordination, implementation and research gaps.
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for a unified regional AI policy framework rather than isolated national strategies
Recommends sovereign regional data infrastructure and compute
Proposes reversing human capital flight through talent and skills measures
Urges targeted regional financing and commercial innovation support
Embeds AI in natural disaster and climate resilience strategies
